marketplace.description: Independent, platform-neutral workflow plugins for Codex and Claude Code.

plugins.description: Minimal project progress and plan/spec storage, with shared document rules for explicit README, planning, architecture, guidance, and organization workflows.

codex.shortDescription: Minimal progress, plan storage, and documentation
codex.longDescription: Track project progress and handle plan/spec file requests. Explicit skills cover documentation setup, refactoring, README and usage, planning, architecture and ADRs, and project guidance using shared references.
defaultPrompt: Use $agent-docs-maintainer:project-docs-bootstrap to initialize a minimal documentation baseline for this repository.
Use $agent-docs-maintainer:project-docs-refactor to audit or reorganize this repository's documentation structure and ownership.
Use $agent-docs-maintainer:project-docs-readme to create or maintain the README, official translations, and task-based usage guide.
Use $agent-docs-maintainer:project-docs-planning to organize TODO, roadmap, milestones, backlog, and plan/spec storage and archiving without rewriting plan/spec content.
Use $agent-docs-maintainer:project-docs-architecture to maintain current or target architecture, Mermaid diagrams, and ADRs.
Use $agent-docs-maintainer:project-docs-guidance to create or refine AGENTS.md, scoped rules, and the CLAUDE.md symlink.
Use $agent-docs-maintainer:project-docs-progress to continue the current task with minimal progress, or create, save, and link a project plan/spec file using project storage conventions.

plugins.description: Explicitly invoked guidance for resuming authorized work after short-term or weekly quota recovery, with execution tracking and permission-bound reset credits.

codex.shortDescription: Resume authorized work after quota recovery
codex.longDescription: Create or repair continuation schedules with five-hour and weekly quota checks, existing-session routing, execution tracking, and duplicate prevention. Use reset credits only within explicit user authorization and stop on completion or required user action. Includes Codex and Linux systemd guidance; installation alone starts no scheduler.
defaultPrompt: Use $agent-task-resume:quota-resume to schedule this authorized task to resume after its five-hour quota recovers, track execution, and stop on completion or required user action.

plugins.description: Development standards and practices for AI coding agents, tailored to personal preferences.

codex.longDescription: Development standards and practices for AI coding agents, tailored to personal preferences. Currently includes code-comment review and uv/hatchling Python project configuration.
defaultPrompt: Use $agent-dev-standards:code-comment-standard to review comments in the requested files. Explain specific reading gaps and show focused rewrites without editing files.
Use $agent-dev-standards:pyproject-standard to review this Python project configuration.
